rules: No demographic or party label selects a position.
Record the life fact, learned message, recipient, trust and existing conviction for each change.
A generic conversation or mere relationship does not prove that political content was communicated.
Only recipients of a recorded event or message receive political exposure.
Keep opinion absence, salience, conviction, engagement and public expression separate.
A state estimate sampling error is not town heterogeneity.
